name: UI：任务管理-编辑弹窗基础设置字段验证
description: 验证编辑弹窗基础设置区：审核标准/优先级/预期交付时间/难度预估/人效预估

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)') || document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { hasForm: false }; const t = modal.textContent; const fields = ['审核标准','优先级','预期交付时间','难度预估','人效预估']; const found = fields.filter(f => t.includes(f)); const priorityVal = modal.querySelector('[class*=select]')?.textContent?.trim(); return { hasForm: true, fields, found, coverage: found.length+'/'+fields.length }; })()
(() => { const cancel = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '取 消'); if(cancel) cancel.click(); return 'cancelled'; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 审核标准/优先级(必填)/预期交付时间(必填)/难度预估/人效预估(必填,条/小时)
